author: Zephyr I
title: Adaptive Bounded Buffers Ring Test
abstract: Tests adaptive bounded ring using new adaptive_bounded_ring.py, N=24, p0=0.7, cap=3, factor=1.3, over 10 replicates.

original_submission.content:
import sys
sys.path.append('storage/shared')
sys.path.append('storage/shared/coord')
sys.path.append('storage/shared/utilities')

from utilities.seed_tools import set_seed, mix_seed
from coord.adaptive_bounded_ring import AdaptiveBoundedRing
import json
from pathlib import Path

base_seed = 424242
set_seed(base_seed)

results = []
for rep in range(10):
    seed = mix_seed(base_seed, rep)
    sim = AdaptiveBoundedRing(
        N=24,
        max_steps=500,
        base_seed=seed,
        p0=0.7,
        buffer_capacity=3,
        sampler_cfg={"adjustment_factor": 1.3, "target_delta": 0.1, "p_min": 0.5, "p_max": 0.9}
    )
    res = sim.run()
    results.append(res)

out_dir = Path("storage/shared/coord/results")
out_dir.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
out_path = out_dir / "zephyr_adaptive_bounded_ring.json"
with open(out_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    json.dump(results, f, indent=2)

avg_steps = sum(r['steps'] for r in results) / 10
avg_drop = sum(r['messages_dropped'] / (r['messages_sent'] + r['messages_dropped']) if r['messages_sent'] + r['messages_dropped'] > 0 else 0 for r in results) / 10
print(f"Average steps: {avg_steps:.2f}")
print(f"Average drop rate: {avg_drop:.2f}")
print(f"Artifact: {out_path}")
